comment: Deterministic regression check for the axe detection layer. Load the fixture (data: URL or served over http; file:// is blocked in Playwright, but works in the AppleScript Chrome runtime) and run scripts/axe-run.js. PASS = every id in mustFire.violations and mustFire.bestPractice appears in the run's violations, and incomplete matches expectedIncomplete.
notes: Best-practice ids carry an EMPTY wcag tag array; the report must label them 'best practice', not WCAG AA failures.
duplicate-id is intentionally NOT expected: axe removed that rule in 4.x.
The rule set can shift across axe versions. When bumping the pinned version in scripts/axe-run.js, re-run and update this file.
